translationRepairs: On the day jiazi, the Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, Grand General, Grand Marshal Duke of Tang was made provisional bearer of the yellow battle-axe, commissioner holding credentials, Grand Commander of all military affairs at home and abroad, Director of the Department of State Affairs, Grand Chancellor, and was advanced in enfeoffment to Duke of Tang.

On the day jiazi, the Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, Grand General, Grand Marshal Duke of Tang was made provisional bearer of the yellow battle-axe, commissioner holding credentials, Grand Commander of all military affairs at home and abroad, Director of the Department of State Affairs, Grand Chancellor, and was advanced in enfeoffment to Prince of Tang.

s0018 ends with 進封唐王: he is advanced from Duke of Tang (唐公) to Prince of Tang (唐王). The literal wrongly repeats Duke of Tang for the advancement; Prince of Tang matches the Chinese and the idiomatic line.
On the day bingyin, an edict said: "I am but a child, never having left the deep palace; the Retired Emperor tours afar, tracing the tracks of Mu and Man.
On the day bingyin, an edict said: "I am but a child, never having left the deep palace; the Retired Emperor tours afar, tracing the tracks of King Mu (Man).
追蹤穆滿 refers to one person, King Mu of Zhou whose personal name was Man (穆滿), not two figures Mu and Man. King Mu (Man) restores the correct identity while preserving the personal name.

Prince of Qi Yang Jian, Prince of Zhao Yang Gao, Prince of Yan Yang Dan, Yuwen Xie (Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and acting General-in-Chief of the Right Wing Guard), Yu Shiji (Palace Secretary), Pei Yun (Censor-in-Chief), and Xu Shansin (Acting Recorder)—all were killed.

Prince of Qi Yang Jian, Prince of Zhao Yang Gao, Prince of Yan Yang Dan, Yuwen Xie (Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and acting General-in-Chief of the Right Wing Guard), Yu Shiji (Palace Secretary), Pei Yun (Censor-in-Chief), and Xu Shanxin (Acting Recorder)—all were killed.
許善心 romanizes as Xu Shanxin (善 shan + 心 xin). Shansin is a corrupted spelling; the proposed Shanxin is the correct reading.

Prince of Qi Yang Jian, Prince of Zhao Yang Gao, Prince of Yan Yang Dan, Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, Grand Master of the Palace with Honors Equal to the Three Lords and Acting General-in-Chief of the Right Wing Guard Yuwen Xie, Grand Master of the Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon, Palace Secretary Yu Shiji, Grand Master of the Silver Seal and Blue Ribbon, Censor-in-Chief Pei Yun, Grand Master for Discussion of Affairs, Acting Recorder Xu Shansin—all met with violent death.

Prince of Qi Yang Jian, Prince of Zhao Yang Gao, Prince of Yan Yang Dan, Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, Grand Master of the Palace with Honors Equal to the Three Lords and Acting General-in-Chief of the Right Wing Guard Yuwen Xie, Grand Master of the Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon, Palace Secretary Yu Shiji, Grand Master of the Silver Seal and Blue Ribbon, Censor-in-Chief Pei Yun, Grand Master for Discussion of Affairs, Acting Recorder Xu Shanxin—all met with violent death.
The literal likewise misromanizes 許善心 as Xu Shansin; Xu Shanxin is the correct pinyin and matches the idiomatic repair.

The Chancellor of State, Prince of Tang, was born for the age, rescues the endangered and saves the drowning; from north to south, campaigning east while the west complains—he gathers the nine unite in one correction and decides a hundred victories across a thousand leagues; he rallies barbarian and Han alike and shelters the common people, protects and comforts my person—in him alone I rely.

The Chancellor of State, Prince of Tang, was born to answer the needs of the age. He has sustained those in peril and rescued those in distress; as he marched from north to south, the west longed for him when he campaigned in the east. He has gathered the lords nine times and set the realm to rights in one stroke, and won a hundred victories from a thousand li away. He has rallied non-Chinese and Chinese alike, sheltered the common people, and preserved my person. It is upon the prince that I rely.

總九合於一匡 alludes to Duke Huan's repeated assemblies of the lords and restoration of order. The revised paragraph conveys that allusion in coherent English and repairs the surrounding prose without adding historical claims.
